# Overrides applied when compiling semgrep.txt (uv pip compile --override).
#
# mcp: semgrep pins mcp==1.29.0, and every mcp below 1.30.0 is affected by
# GHSA-84m7-p3x7-pcfv, GHSA-w4fh-qvv9-3v23, GHSA-5h93-6whr-6q8j and GHSA-rwrf-2pqf-9j8j,
# all fixed in 1.30.0. semgrep imports mcp only in its MCP server, never in `semgrep scan`,
# which is all semgrep.yaml runs. semgrep.yaml installs with --no-deps so pip does not
# re-apply semgrep's pin. Delete this line once a semgrep release allows mcp 1.30.
mcp>=1.30.0,<2

# opentelemetry: semgrep pins the OpenTelemetry family to ~=1.37.0 / ~=0.58b0, but
# opentelemetry-api <= 1.45.1 is affected by GHSA-xcq7-p3pf-p88h (fixed in 1.45.1) and
# GHSA-mf5v-w3w3-f6cg (fixed in 1.45.2). The whole family moves in lockstep
# (opentelemetry-sdk 1.45.2 requires opentelemetry-api==1.45.2 and
# opentelemetry-semantic-conventions==0.66b2). semgrep uses OpenTelemetry only for its
# opt-in --trace export, which semgrep.yaml does not pass. Delete these lines once a
# semgrep release allows opentelemetry-api >= 1.45.2.
opentelemetry-api==1.45.2
opentelemetry-sdk==1.45.2
opentelemetry-proto==1.45.2
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-common==1.45.2
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http==1.45.2
opentelemetry-semantic-conventions==0.66b2
opentelemetry-instrumentation==0.66b2
opentelemetry-instrumentation-requests==0.66b2
opentelemetry-instrumentation-threading==0.66b2
opentelemetry-util-http==0.66b2
